description.value: Kumo Sukiyaki Restaurant is a Japanese restaurant in Richmond, BC, specializing in sukiyaki — a traditional hot pot dish of thinly sliced beef and vegetables simmered in a sweet soy-based broth. Located in a commercial unit on Anderson Road, it sits within Richmond's dense and diverse Japanese dining scene. A touring cyclist finishing a ride through the Richmond flatlands would find this a sit-down option for a warming, filling Japanese meal.
